Description
1 oz Pamp Suisse Silver Bar Lady Fortuna is manufactured by the bullion brand –
PAMP Suisse
which is recognized around the globe for its innovative designs, state-of-the-art facilities, and industry-leading efforts to curtail
precious metal counterfeiting
.
PAMP Suisse, a prominent Swiss refinery was founded in Ticino in 1977. It quickly rose to prominence due to its outstanding craftsmanship. Investors and Collectors around the glove love the PAMP bullion brand. It Produces high-quality bullion bars and uses the most recent technologies to prevent bullion counterfeiting, Lady Fortuna is one of the most well-known series of the mint.
The 1 oz PAMP Suisse Silver bar contains 1 troy oz of silver of purity .999 and comes with its original tamper-evident assay card which authenticates the weight and purity of the silver. The weight and purity of these silver bars are backed by the PAMP Suisse.
The assaying services of the bullion brand PAMP Sussie are world-famous likewise, it is among the world’s premier private mints which are manufacturing such amazing silver bars and ingots. This is why the silver investors and collectors have trust in precious metal items such as silver and gold from PAMP Suisse.
1 oz Silver Bar – PAMP Lady Fortuna (In Assay)
The 1 oz Silver PAMP Suisse Fortuna Bar is adorned with the well-known Roman Goddess of Fortuna and luck i.e Lady Fortuna. The Roman goddess is depicted holding her traditional horn, overflowing with silver coins. Her sheaves of wheat signify prosperity and her poppies are for remembrance. The Wheel of Fortuna is hidden behind her figure. Fortuna is depicted blindfolded to symbolize her inner knowledge of the world’s ways.
The reverse design of the 1 oz PAMP Suisse Silver Bar – Lady Fortuna features the PAMP Suisse logo which includes the words “PAMP” enclosed inside a four small circle followed by the term “Suisse” just underneath it. The “ESSAYEUR FONDEUR” stamp is essentially a “maker’s mark ” that all the prestigious swiss refineries use on their brand-name products. The other labels arranged in a vertical way on the reverse side are the weight, purity, metal content, and a unique serial number at the .bottom
